description:
We want to change the world. We’re a team of fast-executing social entrepreneurs on a mission to build the future of social change. We’ve bootstrapped our development so far, but we’ve gotten to a critical point in our growth where we need to add a backend developer to our growing Core Team.  This position will begin as part-time, but you should expect your role to grow as iFLIP4 grows!
 
 
 We don’t want a code monkey; we don’t want someone to say yes and implement every feature we ask for. What we want is a partner. Someone to bounce ideas off of, someone with a vision for the future of our company, and someone who has the desire and drive to make it a reality. 

 Technical Requirements: 
 
 Expert in ExpressionEngine CMS Platform preferred 
 Ability to build add-ons & modules for ExpressionEngine 
 PHP (5+, OO PHP), and MySQL/SQL Database Experience (LAMP stack) 
 Git, software engineering best practices 
 Server Admin & maintaining DBs 
 Sysadmin/Scaling experience (site is Rackspace hosted) 
 Pursuing or hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering or similar 
 Javascript (jQuery programming) a plus 
 
 Time and Pay: 
This is primarily an equity position, with a negotiable stipend to start. It will begin as part-time, but the responsibilities will expand as iFLIP4 grows. We are located in East Hanover, NJ, and telecommuting is fine with us.

Please send your resume to Dave@iFLIP4.com by 4/8. Preference will be given to those who apply earliest.
 
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
